export interface GearItem {
  id: string
  user_id: string
  item_type: string
  brand?: string | null
  model?: string | null
  label?: string | null
  consumable: boolean
  weight_g: number
  weight_display_unit?: WeightUnit
  price?: number | null
  description?: string | null
  image_url?: string | null
  url?: string | null
  notes?: string | null
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export interface List {
  id: string
  user_id: string
  name: string
  gear_ids: string[]
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export interface ListCategory {
  id: string
  list_id: string
  name: string
  sort_index: number
  icon?: string | null
  color?: string | null
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export interface ListedGearItem {
  id: string
  gear_id: string
  list_category_id: string
  quantity: number
  worn: boolean
  sort_index: number
  weight_g_override?: number | null
  notes?: string | null
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export type GearCategory =
  | 'Shelter'
  | 'Sleep System'
  | 'Cooking'
  | 'Water'
  | 'Clothing'
  | 'Electronics'
  | 'First Aid'
  | 'Navigation'
  | 'Other'

export type WeightUnit = 'g' | 'oz' | 'lb' | 'kg'

export interface WeightInput {
  value: number
  unit: WeightUnit
}

export interface UserProfile {
  id: string
  user_id: string
  username: string
  display_name: string
  avatar_url?: string | null
  location?: string | null
  about_me?: string | null
  is_public: boolean

  updated_at: string
}

export interface ProfileFormData {
  username: string
  display_name: string
  location?: string
  about_me?: string
  is_public: boolean
}

     7→
     8→export interface LighterPackParseResult {
     9→  success: boolean
    10→  data: ParsedGearItemWithUnit[]
    11→  errors: string[]
    12→  metadata?: {
    13→    listName?: string
    14→    totalWeight?: number
    15→    itemCount?: number

    17→}
    18→
    19→// Category emoji mappings from LighterPack

    21→  '🥾': 'Footwear',
    22→  '🥋': 'Clothing',
    23→  '⚡️': 'Electronics',

    36→}
    37→
    38→/**
    39→ * Parse a LighterPack public list URL
    40→ */
    41→export async function parseLighterPackUrl(url: string): Promise<LighterPackParseResult> {
    42→  const result: LighterPackParseResult = {
    43→    success: false,
    44→    data: [],
    45→    errors: []
    46→  }
    47→
    48→  try {
    49→    // Validate URL format
    50→    if (!isValidLighterPackUrl(url)) {
    51→      result.errors.push('Invalid LighterPack URL format. Expected: https://lighterpack.com/r/[ID]')
    52→      return result
    53→    }
    54→
    55→    // For now, we'll create a proxy approach since we can't directly fetch cross-origin
    56→    // In a real implementation, this would either:
    57→    // 1. Use a backend proxy to fetch the LighterPack page
    58→    // 2. Use a CORS proxy service
    59→    // 3. Have users paste the HTML content
    60→
    61→    result.errors.push('Direct URL import not yet implemented. Please use CSV export from LighterPack for now.')
    62→    return result
    63→
    64→  } catch (error) {
    65→    result.errors.push(`Failed to parse LighterPack URL: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`)
    66→    return result
    67→  }
    68→}
    69→
    70→/**
    71→ * Parse LighterPack HTML content (for when we have the HTML)
    72→ */
    73→export function parseLighterPackHtml(html: string): LighterPackParseResult {
    74→  const result: LighterPackParseResult = {
    75→    success: true,
    76→    data: [],
    77→    errors: [],
    78→    metadata: {}
    79→  }
    80→
    81→  try {
    82→    // Create a DOM parser to work with the HTML
    83→    const parser = new DOMParser()
    84→    const doc = parser.parseFromString(html, 'text/html')
    85→
    86→    // Extract list metadata - try multiple selectors for the list name
    87→    let listName = 'LighterPack List'
    88→
    89→    // First try the list name element
    90→    const listNameElement = doc.querySelector('.lpListName, h1.lpListName')
    91→    if (listNameElement?.textContent?.trim()) {
    92→      listName = listNameElement.textContent.trim()
    93→    } else {
    94→      // Fallback to title element, but clean it up
    95→      const titleElement = doc.querySelector('title')
    96→      const titleText = titleElement?.textContent?.trim()
    97→      if (titleText && !titleText.includes('LighterPack') && titleText !== 'LighterPack') {
    98→        listName = titleText
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→
   102→    result.metadata!.listName = listName
   103→
   104→    // Try to parse the chartData JSON first
   105→    const chartData = extractChartData(html)
   106→    if (chartData) {
   107→      console.log('[DEBUG] Using chartData parsing method')
   108→      result.data = parseChartData(chartData)
   109→    }
   110→
   111→    // Fallback to HTML parsing if chartData fails
   112→    if (result.data.length === 0) {
   113→      console.log('[DEBUG] Using HTML structure parsing method')
   114→      result.data = parseHtmlStructure(doc)
   115→    }
   116→
   117→    // Calculate metadata
   118→    result.metadata!.itemCount = result.data.length
   119→    result.metadata!.totalWeight = result.data.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.weight_g, 0)
   120→
   121→    if (result.data.length === 0) {
   122→      result.success = false
   123→      result.errors.push('No gear items found in the LighterPack page')
   124→    }
   125→
   126→  } catch (error) {
   127→    result.success = false
   128→    result.errors.push(`Failed to parse HTML: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`)
   129→  }
   130→
   131→  return result
   132→}
   133→
   134→/**
   135→ * Validate LighterPack URL format
   136→ */
   137→function isValidLighterPackUrl(url: string): boolean {
   138→  try {
   139→    const urlObj = new URL(url)
   140→    return urlObj.hostname === 'lighterpack.com' && urlObj.pathname.startsWith('/r/')
   141→  } catch {
   142→    return false
   143→  }
   144→}
   145→
   146→/**
   147→ * Extract chartData parameter from the HTML
   148→ */
   149→function extractChartData(html: string): any | null {
   150→  try {
   151→    // Look for chartData parameter in the HTML
   152→    const chartDataMatch = html.match(/chartData["\s]*=["\s]*([^"]+)/)
   153→    if (!chartDataMatch) return null
   154→
   155→    // Decode the URL-encoded JSON string
   156→    const encodedData = chartDataMatch[1]
   157→    const decodedData = decodeURIComponent(encodedData)
   158→
   159→    return JSON.parse(decodedData)
   160→  } catch {
   161→    return null
   162→  }
   163→}
   164→
   165→/**
   166→ * Parse the chartData JSON structure
   167→ */
   168→function parseChartData(chartData: any): ParsedGearItemWithUnit[] {
   169→  const items: ParsedGearItemWithUnit[] = []
   170→
   171→  try {
   172→    // ChartData structure varies, but typically has categories with items
   173→    if (chartData.children) {
   174→      for (const category of chartData.children) {
   175→        const categoryName = mapEmojiToCategory(category.name) || 'Other'
   176→
   177→        if (category.children) {
   178→          for (const item of category.children) {
   179→            const gearItem = parseChartDataItem(item, categoryName)
   180→            if (gearItem) {
   181→              items.push(gearItem)
   182→            }
   183→          }
   184→        }
   185→      }
   186→    }
   187→  } catch (error) {
   188→    // Fallback to empty array if parsing fails
   189→    console.warn('Failed to parse chartData:', error)
   190→  }
   191→
   192→  return items
   193→}
   194→
   195→/**
   196→ * Parse individual item from chartData
   197→ */
   198→function parseChartDataItem(item: any, category: string): ParsedGearItemWithUnit | null {
   199→  try {
   200→    const label = item.name?.trim()
   201→    if (!label) return null
   202→
   203→    // Chart data might have weight in different formats
   204→    let weight_g = parseFloat(item.weight) || 0
   205→    console.log(`[DEBUG] chartData item: ${item.name}, raw weight: ${item.weight}, parsed: ${weight_g}`)
   206→
   207→    // Check if this looks like milligrams (very large numbers)
   208→    if (weight_g > 10000) {
   209→      console.log(`[DEBUG] Looks like milligrams, converting: ${weight_g}mg -> ${weight_g / 1000}g`)
   210→      weight_g = weight_g / 1000
   211→    }
   212→
   213→    if (weight_g <= 0) return null
   214→
   215→    // Try to detect unit from raw weight string if available
   216→    let unit: WeightUnit = 'g'
   217→    if (item.weightText) {
   218→      const { unit: detectedUnit } = parseWeightFromText(item.weightText)
   219→      unit = detectedUnit
   220→    }
   221→
   222→    return {
   223→      label,
   224→      weight_g: Math.round(weight_g),
   225→      weight_display_unit: unit,
   226→      item_type: category,
   227→      worn: item.worn === true || item.worn === 'true',
   228→      consumable: item.consumable === true || item.consumable === 'true',
   229→      price: item.price ? parseFloat(item.price) : undefined,
   230→      description: item.description?.trim() || undefined,
   231→      notes: item.notes?.trim() || undefined,
   232→      url: item.url?.trim() || undefined
   233→    }
   234→  } catch {
   235→    return null
   236→  }
   237→}
   238→
   239→/**
   240→ * Fallback HTML structure parsing
   241→ */
   242→function parseHtmlStructure(doc: Document): ParsedGearItemWithUnit[] {
   243→  const items: ParsedGearItemWithUnit[] = []
   244→
   245→  try {
   246→    // Parse LighterPack's actual HTML structure
   247→    const categoryElements = doc.querySelectorAll('.lpCategory')
   248→
   249→    for (const categoryEl of categoryElements) {
   250→      // Get category name
   251→      const categoryNameEl = categoryEl.querySelector('.lpCategoryName')
   252→      const categoryName = categoryNameEl?.textContent?.trim() || 'Other'
   253→
   254→      // Get all items in this category
   255→      const itemElements = categoryEl.querySelectorAll('.lpItem')
   256→
   257→      for (const itemEl of itemElements) {
   258→        const item = parseHtmlItem(itemEl, categoryName)
   259→        if (item) {
   260→          items.push(item)
   261→        }
   262→      }
   263→    }
   264→  } catch (error) {
   265→    console.warn('Failed to parse HTML structure:', error)
   266→  }
   267→
   268→  return items
   269→}
   270→
   271→/**
   272→ * Parse individual HTML item element for gear data
   273→ */
   274→function parseHtmlItem(element: Element, category: string): ParsedGearItemWithUnit | null {
   275→  try {
   276→    // Extract name from lpName span
   277→    const nameEl = element.querySelector('.lpName')
   278→    const name = nameEl?.textContent?.trim()
   279→    if (!name) return null
   280→
   281→    // Extract description from lpDescription span
   282→    const descriptionEl = element.querySelector('.lpDescription')
   283→    const description = descriptionEl?.textContent?.trim()
   284→
   285→    // Combine name and description if description exists
   286→    const fullName = description ? `${name} - ${description}` : name
   287→
   288→    // Extract weight from lpWeightCell - need to get value and unit separately
   289→    const weightEl = element.querySelector('.lpWeight')
   290→    const weightValue = weightEl?.textContent?.trim() || '0'
   291→
   292→    // Get the unit from lpDisplay span within lpUnitSelect
   293→    const unitEl = element.querySelector('.lpUnitSelect .lpDisplay')
   294→    const unitText = unitEl?.textContent?.trim() || 'g'
   295→
   296→    console.log(`[DEBUG] HTML item weight: value="${weightValue}", unit="${unitText}"`)
   297→
   298→    // Combine value and unit for parsing
   299→    const weightText = `${weightValue}${unitText}`
   300→    const { grams, unit } = parseWeightFromText(weightText)
   301→
   302→    // Check for worn flag - try multiple approaches
   303→    let isWorn = false
   304→    let isConsumable = false
   305→
   306→    try {
   307→      // First try: look for active worn/consumable icons
   308→      const wornIcon = element.querySelector('.lpWorn.lpActive') || element.querySelector('i.lpWorn.lpActive')
   309→      const consumableIcon = element.querySelector('.lpConsumable.lpActive') ||
   310→        element.querySelector('i.lpConsumable.lpActive')
   311→
   312→      isWorn = wornIcon !== null
   313→      isConsumable = consumableIcon !== null
   314→
   315→      // Fallback: check element classes (original logic)
   316→      if (!isWorn && !isConsumable) {
   317→        isWorn = element.classList.contains('lpShowWorn')
   318→        isConsumable = element.classList.contains('lpShowConsumable')
   319→      }
   320→    } catch (error) {
   321→      // Ultimate fallback: default to false
   322→      console.warn('[DEBUG] Error parsing worn/consumable flags:', error)
   323→      isWorn = false
   324→      isConsumable = false
   325→    }
   326→
   327→    console.log(`[DEBUG] HTML item flags: ${fullName} - worn: ${isWorn}, consumable: ${isConsumable}`)
   328→
   329→    // Extract price if present
   330→    const priceEl = element.querySelector('.lpPriceCell')
   331→    const priceText = priceEl?.textContent?.trim()
   332→    let price: number | undefined
   333→    if (priceText) {
   334→      const priceMatch = priceText.match(/[\d.,]+/)
   335→      if (priceMatch) {
   336→        price = parseFloat(priceMatch[0].replace(',', ''))
   337→      }
   338→    }
   339→
   340→    // Extract URL if present - look for link elements or URL text
   341→    const linkEl = element.querySelector('a[href]')
   342→    const url = linkEl?.getAttribute('href')?.trim() || undefined
   343→
   344→    return {
   345→      label: fullName,
   346→      weight_g: grams,
   347→      weight_display_unit: unit,
   348→      item_type: mapCategoryName(category),
   349→      worn: isWorn,
   350→      consumable: isConsumable,
   351→      price,
   352→      description: description || undefined,
   353→      url
   354→    }
   355→  } catch {
   356→    return null
   357→  }
   358→}
   359→
   360→/**
   361→ * Map LighterPack category names to BetterPack categories
   362→ */
   363→function mapCategoryName(lighterPackCategory: string): string {
   364→  const normalized = lighterPackCategory.toLowerCase().trim()
   365→
   366→  // Direct mappings for common LighterPack categories
   367→  const mappings: Record<string, string> = {
   368→    'shelter': 'Shelter',
   369→    'sleep system': 'Sleep System',
   370→    'sleep': 'Sleep System',
   371→    'cooking': 'Cooking',
   372→    'cook': 'Cooking',
   373→    'water': 'Water',
   374→    'hydration': 'Water',
   375→    'clothing': 'Clothing',
   376→    'clothes': 'Clothing',
   377→    'worn clothing': 'Clothing',
   378→    'electronics': 'Electronics',
   379→    'first aid': 'First Aid',
   380→    'medical': 'First Aid',
   381→    'navigation': 'Navigation',
   382→    'nav': 'Navigation',
   383→    'other': 'Other',
   384→    'misc': 'Other',
   385→    'miscellaneous': 'Other'
   386→  }
   387→
   388→  // Check for direct match
   389→  if (mappings[normalized]) {
   390→    return mappings[normalized]
   391→  }
   392→
   393→  // Check for partial matches
   394→  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(mappings)) {
   395→    if (normalized.includes(key)) {
   396→      return value
   397→    }
   398→  }
   399→
   400→  // Default to Other if no match found
   401→  return 'Other'
   402→}
   403→
   404→/**
   405→ * Map emoji categories to our category names
   406→ */
   407→function mapEmojiToCategory(emojiCategory: string): string | null {
   408→  for (const [emoji, category] of Object.entries(CATEGORY_MAPPINGS)) {
   409→    if (emojiCategory.includes(emoji)) {
   410→      return category
   411→    }
   412→  }
   413→  return null
   414→}
   415→
   416→/**
   417→ * Parse weight from text (handles various formats) and returns both grams and unit
   418→ */
   419→function parseWeightFromText(text: string): { grams: number; unit: WeightUnit } {
   420→  console.log(`[DEBUG] parseWeightFromText input: "${text}"`)
   421→  const cleaned = text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\d.,ozlbkg\s]/g, '').trim()
   422→  console.log(`[DEBUG] cleaned: "${cleaned}"`)
   423→
   424→  // First check for combined lb + oz format (e.g., "1 lb 5 oz")
   425→  if (cleaned.includes('lb') && cleaned.includes('oz')) {
   426→    const lbOzMatch = cleaned.match(/(\d+\.?\d*)\s*lb\s*(\d+\.?\d*)\s*oz/)
   427→    if (lbOzMatch) {
   428→      const lbs = parseFloat(lbOzMatch[1])
   429→      const ozs = parseFloat(lbOzMatch[2])
   430→      return {
   431→        grams: Math.round((lbs * 453.592) + (ozs * 28.3495)),
   432→        unit: 'oz' // Display in oz since it has oz precision
   433→      }
   434→    }
   435→  }
   436→
   437→  const numberMatch = cleaned.match(/([\d.,]+)/)
   438→  if (!numberMatch) return { grams: 0, unit: 'g' }
   439→
   440→  const value = parseFloat(numberMatch[1].replace(',', ''))
   441→  console.log(`[DEBUG] parsed value: ${value}`)
   442→  if (isNaN(value)) return { grams: 0, unit: 'g' }
   443→
   444→  // Check unit and convert to grams
   445→  if (cleaned.includes('oz') && !cleaned.includes('lb')) {
   446→    const grams = Math.round(value * 28.3495)
   447→    console.log(`[DEBUG] ${value} oz -> ${grams}g`)
   448→    return {
   449→      grams, // Convert oz to grams
   450→      unit: 'oz'
   451→    }
   452→  } else if (cleaned.includes('lb')) {
   453→    const grams = Math.round(value * 453.592)
   454→    console.log(`[DEBUG] ${value} lb -> ${grams}g`)
   455→    return {
   456→      grams, // Convert lb to grams
   457→      unit: 'lb'
   458→    }
   459→  } else if (cleaned.includes('kg')) {

**Fixed!** The LighterPack import issue was in `ImportPreview.tsx` - it was using old field names (`item.name`, `item.category`, `item.weight_grams`) instead of the new ones (`item.label`, `item.item_type`, `item.weight_g`).

**To fix everything:**
1. **Run these 3 migrations** in Supabase SQL editor:
   - `009_create_list_categories.sql`
   - `010_create_listed_gear_item.sql` 
   - `011_update_gear_items_schema.sql`

2. **Import field mapping is now fixed** - the duplicates preview will show correct data

The LighterPack parser itself was already correctly outputting the right format with `item_type`, `label`, and `weight_g`. The issue was just in the UI preview component.
